title: 🗣️ حوار الاستماع التفاعلي (Listening Dialogue - SB Page 15)
description: 💡 حوار بين مقدم برنامج "Our Story" وعالمة الآثار د. منى حسن (Dr. Mona Hassan) حول مشروع ترميم معبد فيلة وأهمية حماية تراثنا القومي وإلهام الشباب.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Host (المذيع)
turns.en: Welcome back to "Our Story". Today, we're talking to Dr. Mona Hassan, an archaeologist who recently led a team to restore parts of the Philae Temple. Dr. Mona, thank you for joining us.

turns.speaker: 🏛️ Dr. Mona Hassan (د. منى حسن)
turns.en: Thank you. It's a privilege to be here.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Host (المذيع)
turns.en: Your work on Philae is a powerful symbol. Can you tell us why preserving our heritage is so important?

turns.speaker: 🏛️ Dr. Mona Hassan (د. منى حسن)
turns.en: Of course. When we restore a historical site, we're not just fixing old stones. We're reconnecting with our past. Our ancestors left us a rich legacy—from the pyramids to the temples of Upper Egypt. This heritage is the core of our national identity. It reminds us of who we are, where we came from, and the greatness we are capable of. It's a source of immense pride for every Egyptian.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Host (المذيع)
turns.en: It sounds like more than a job; it's a mission. What do you think is the biggest challenge to preserving our heritage today?

turns.speaker: 🏛️ Dr. Mona Hassan (د. منى حسن)
turns.en: The challenges are many, from urban development to climate change. But perhaps the biggest is a lack of awareness among our youth. Many young people don't realize the value of these treasures. Our job is to inspire them, to make them see that a thousand-year-old temple is not just a tourist attraction—it's a living part of our story. We need to encourage them to visit these sites, to learn the stories, and to feel the connection.

turns.speaker: 🎙️ Host (المذيع)
turns.en: That's a great point. You're inspiring them to become the next generation of protectors. Thank you, for your valuable work, Dr. Mona.
